subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Should user-visible transient provider-error replies include only provider/model, or also active-profile presence and trigger as proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55851?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the exact diagnostic fields become delivered chat text across transports and need maintainer product/privacy judgment before the linked PR can land.

options.title: Accept Safe Provider/Model Context
options.body: Refresh the linked PR or equivalent so delivered replies include provider/model and only safe non-identifying extras that maintainers explicitly approve.

options.title: Narrow To Provider/Model Only
options.body: Keep profile presence and trigger in logs or lifecycle metadata while delivering only provider/model in chat replies.

options.title: Defer Visible Diagnostics
options.body: Leave user-facing copy generic for now and track provider attribution as a broader diagnostics design decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Safe Provider/Model Context
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR or equivalent so delivered replies include provider/model and only safe non-identifying extras that maintainers explicitly approve.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent ownership signals on the extracted AI runtime/error-helper surface and is a plausible owner for the product boundary decision.
